risks.title: Legacy Payment Gateway Key Exhaustion
risks.description: Our primary payment gateway uses legacy RSA-2048 keys with high session concurrency. During peak transaction bursts, cryptographic key exhaustion causes timeout errors and potential transaction drops.
risks.mitigationPlan: Initiate an immediate technical audit of the payment gateway's cryptographic infrastructure to assess current key rotation policies and concurrency limits. Implement a phased migration strategy to modern elliptic curve cryptography (ECC) or RSA-4096 to reduce computational overhead per transaction. Deploy load balancing mechanisms specifically optimized for cryptographic operations and establish real-time monitoring alerts for key exhaustion thresholds to prevent service degradation during peak loads.
risks.contingencyPlan: If key exhaustion occurs during a peak burst, immediately activate a failover to a secondary, pre-provisioned payment gateway instance with independent key pools. Implement a temporary rate-limiting protocol to throttle non-critical transactions and prioritize high-value payments. Engage the vendor support team for emergency key regeneration and patch application, while communicating potential delays to stakeholders and initiating manual reconciliation processes for any dropped transactions to ensure financial integrity.

risks.title: Backend Developer Unavailability Delaying Deployment
risks.description: The backend developer may be unavailable during the final week, which could delay deployment and critical staging sign-off.
risks.mitigationPlan: Implement a knowledge transfer protocol where the backend developer documents all critical deployment steps and staging configurations two weeks prior to the final week. Additionally, identify and onboard a secondary backend engineer or senior developer to shadow the primary developer during the final two weeks to ensure seamless handover if unavailability occurs.
risks.contingencyPlan: If the backend developer becomes unavailable, immediately activate the secondary engineer to take over deployment tasks. If no secondary engineer is available, engage a pre-vetted external contractor with specific backend expertise to handle the critical staging sign-off and deployment, prioritizing this resource allocation above all other non-critical tasks.

auditLogs.changesSummary: Registered risk RSK-201: "Legacy Payment Gateway Key Exhaustion" (Score: 20/25).

newData.title: Legacy Payment Gateway Key Exhaustion
newData.description: Our primary payment gateway uses legacy RSA-2048 keys with high session concurrency. During peak transaction bursts, cryptographic key exhaustion causes timeout errors and potential transaction drops.
newData.mitigationPlan: Initiate an immediate technical audit of the payment gateway's cryptographic infrastructure to assess current key rotation policies and concurrency limits. Implement a phased migration strategy to modern elliptic curve cryptography (ECC) or RSA-4096 to reduce computational overhead per transaction. Deploy load balancing mechanisms specifically optimized for cryptographic operations and establish real-time monitoring alerts for key exhaustion thresholds to prevent service degradation during peak loads.
newData.contingencyPlan: If key exhaustion occurs during a peak burst, immediately activate a failover to a secondary, pre-provisioned payment gateway instance with independent key pools. Implement a temporary rate-limiting protocol to throttle non-critical transactions and prioritize high-value payments. Engage the vendor support team for emergency key regeneration and patch application, while communicating potential delays to stakeholders and initiating manual reconciliation processes for any dropped transactions to ensure financial integrity.
